{"reason": "All 8 example failures are demand-forecast-error rows v1 labeled unknown: three have forecast-bias with bias-amount 0.065-0.081 just under the 0.1 cutoff, five have market-mismatch with bias 0.0. I lower the bias threshold to 0.05 and add a market-signal-mismatch branch returning 'demand-forecast-error, recovering these amounts without altering supplier-delay logic.", "source": "(define (claim-root-cause expedite-event)
  (cond
    ((and (edi-increase? expedite-event)
          (supplier-lead-time-miss? expedite-event))
     'supplier-delay)
    ((and (forecast-bias? expedite-event)
          (> (bias-amount expedite-event) 0.05))
     'demand-forecast-error)
    ((market-signal-mismatch? expedite-event)
     'demand-forecast-error)
    (else 'unknown)))"}
